'''2008 Worlds Team Justin Desai LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Worlds Team Tournament 10/10/2008. Abbreviations expanded best-effort; several lines partially illegible.
